content.stem: 以下哪种公司结构由于透明度降低而具有更高的洗钱风险？(选择三项.)

options.A: 在外国司法管辖区注册成立的有限责任公司
options.B: 一家在避税天堂管辖区没有任何业务活动的私营公司
options.C: 在当地司法管辖区设有代名股东和董事的公司
options.D: 一家在避税天堂司法管辖区注册成立的无记名股票公司
options.E: 一家在设有严格保密法的避税天堂司法管辖区注册成立的私人投资公司

content.stem_en: Which of the following corporate structures present a higher money laundering risk because of reduced transparency? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: A limited liability company incorporated in a foreign jurisdiction
options_en.B: A private company that has no activity in a tax haven jurisdiction
options_en.C: A company with nominee shareholders and directors in a local jurisdiction
options_en.D: A company with bearer shares incorporated in a tax haven jurisdiction
options_en.E: A private investment company incorporated in a tax haven jurisdiction with strict secrecy laws
